title: Group Director Tatsuya Harada delivered a lecture at the French Japanese Conference on Physical and Multimodal AI for Robotics (Nov. 17, 2026)
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: Group Director Tatsuya Harada delivered a lecture at the French Japanese Conference on Physical and Multimodal AI for Robotics. This conference brought together leading researchers, industry experts and innovative startups from France and Japan to explore the rapidly evolving convergence of AI and robotics. Group Director Harada delivered a lecture titled “Building Dexterous Robots with Multimodal Physical AI.” In his lecture, he presented a comprehensive strategy for physical AI that combines sensing, embodiment, learning, control, and deployment within a single integrated framework. He also introduced new NEDO R&D project for the development of dexterous manipulation intelligence in physical machines.
